name: memory
description: Personal persistent memory — auto-recalls relevant memories before each prompt and captures conversation summaries after each turn. Backed by a Cloudflare Worker with Durable Object SQLite + FTS5 search. Auth via Allen Labs SSO.

interface.longDescription: Automatically recalls relevant memories before each prompt and captures conversation summaries after each turn. Memories are stored in a Cloudflare Worker with Durable Object SQLite + FTS5 full-text search. Authentication via Allen Labs SSO (JWT/JWKS).
